question: The Battle of Khatoli was fought in 1517 between the kingdom of Mewar under Rana Sanga and ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ibrahim Lodi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On the death of Sikander Lodi in A.D. 1517, his son Ibrahim Lodi succeeded him.
 
• He was engaged in putting down the revolutions of his patricians when news of Rana Sanga's encroachments reached him.
 
• He prepared an army and marched against Mewar.
 
• The Maharana advanced to meet him and the two armies met near the vill of Khatoli on the borders of Haravati( Haraoti).
 
• The Delhi army couldn't stand the rush of the Rajputs, and after a fight lasting two pahars( 5 hours), it gave way and fled, followed by the Sultan himself, leaving a Lodi prince internee in the hands of Sanga.
 
• In this battle, the Maharana lost an arm to a brand cut, and an arrow made him lame for life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sikander Lodi:**

 
 
• Sikandar Khan Lodi, often known as Nizam Khan, was a Pashtun Ruler of the Delhi Sultanate from 1489 until 1517.
 
• In the year 1517, Sikandar Lodi died.
 
• After his father Bahlul Khan Lodi passed away in July 1489, he ascended to the throne of the Lodi dynasty.
 
 
 
• **Babur:**
 
 
• Babur is the founder of the Mughal Empire in India.
 
• He was an assignee of Timur( on his father’s side) and Genghis Khan( on his mama’s side).
 
• His original name was Zahiruddin Muhammad.
 
 
 
• **Mahmud Lodi:**
 
 
• Sultan Mahmud Lodi, who aspired to the throne of Delhi and who had been declared the due heir at law to the Delhi Sultanate by the Western Afghan Confederates and backed by the Rajput Confederates, was put to flight after the defeat at the Battle of Khanwa in 1527.
